item.title: An inflation report Wednesday should be a big deal for the Fed. Here's what to expect
item.description: The consumer price index is expected to show only a modest increase for July.

item.title: Houthi attack kills six in first fatalities in Red Sea in over a year; U.S. strikes container ship
item.description: A cargoship and containership have been hit in the Red Sea and Gulf of Oman as the war inflicts a toll on the world's critical shipping lanes.

item.title: CoreWeave surges 18% in premarket after a 'cleaner quarter'. Here's what's happening
item.description: AI cloud giant CoreWeave jumped in premarket trading after reporting that its second-quarter revenue doubled on surging AI demand from hyperscalers.

item.title: World's largest sovereign wealth fund posts record $184 billion profit as it reveals SpaceX stake for the first time
item.description: The fund — currently valued at around $2.34 trillion — is an investor in more than 7,000 companies across 60 countries.

item.title: Google’s new AI boss inherits a race to catch OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description: Koray Kavukcuoglu is taking charge of Google DeepMind as it tries to keep Gemini competitive with OpenAI and Anthropic.

item.title: Investors poured $2.3 billion into this riskier corner of the bond market in July
item.description: Investors are drawn to collateralized loan obligations for their attractive yields.

item.title: Hormuz closure squeezes global economy as oil demand destruction intensifies, IEA says
item.description: The IEA expects oil demand to fall by 1.6 million barrels a day in 2026 as high fuel prices and Strait of Hormuz disruptions weigh on consumption.

item.title: Sen. Darline Graham advances to Republican special primary runoff in South Carolina
item.description: Progressive Democrats keep their winning streak rolling in Minnesota.

item.title: New York City Council announces probe into prediction market platforms’ marketing strategies
item.description: In letters to four prediction market platforms, City Council Speaker Julie Menin said the council was also actively considering legislation to address concerns.

item.title: Why the historic U.S.-Japan intervention has failed to halt the yen’s slide
item.description: The Japanese yen has erased about half of the gains from an unprecedented U.S.-Japan intervention less than two weeks ago.

item.title: EVs dominate China’s car market: 5 takeaways from the country's latest auto sales data
item.description: The China Passenger Car Association released data Tuesday showing penetration of new energy vehicles rose in July. Tesla's Model Y remained popular.

item.title: China’s answer to Boeing and Airbus makes first international flight — could COMAC challenge the aviation duopoly?
item.description: China’s C919 has made its first scheduled international commercial flight, a milestone in COMAC’s bid to challenge Boeing and Airbus globally.

item.title: Cramer says ask yourself these 3 questions to figure out what's really happening in the market
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors can quickly gauge the market by focusing on three things: bonds, oil and Nvidia.

item.title: Parents could put pretax paycheck money into Trump Accounts, with employers matching, Treasury says
item.description: The U.S. Department of the Treasury issued guidance that could allow parents to make pretax contributions to a child's Trump Account directly from their paycheck.

item.title: Chinese tech giant Tencent posts revenue beat on accelerating games sales, AI-driven ads
item.description: Tencent stock was down 26% so far in 2026 as the company faces intense competition in China in AI and investors grow jittery about its rising spending.

item.title: Treasury yields are little changed as investors await key inflation data
item.description: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — was largely flat at 4.682%.

item.description: Washington and Tehran remain far apart even as both sides talked of winding down regional hostilities.

item.description: Trump in a Truth Social post called Mamdani's pied-à-terre tax a "dangerous political 'experiment' in New York will destroy" the city and state.

item.title: Trump administration ends Medicaid, CHIP funding for gender-affirming care for children
item.description: Federal dollars in the two health insurance programs would not go toward gender-affirming care, but states could still cover the treatments.

item.title: Trump wants to split the MMR vaccine. Experts say that's unlikely — and comes with consequences
item.description: Doctors and other experts say that splitting the measles, mumps and rubella shot has no scientific basis and is unlikely to get off the ground.
